paragraphs: We are not just a community. We are a launchpad for world-class African startups: a place for founders, operators and investors to meet, learn and build, on purpose.
A directory of founders, operators and investors across the continent, searchable by what they do and where.
Book a session with a vetted mentor. Real experience, one conversation at a time.
Score your idea, write the plan, model the numbers and build the deck, all in one private workspace.
Practical courses on foundations, fundraising and growth, with certificates you can share.
A job board where every role comes from someone in the community.
Demo days, workshops and meetups, with registration and reminders built in.
A profile that tells your story, with you in control of who sees what
Introductions to mentors who have built what you are building
A private launch toolkit: validation score, business plan, forecast, deck and prototype
First access to demo days, programmes and funding news
Admission is by application so the rooms stay useful. Tell us what you are building and an admin will reply by email.
Africa’s most intentional founder, operator and investor ecosystem.
